description: Defines a lockless, thread-safe queue template class 'LocklessQueue' with push and pop operations, including internal 'Entry' class, using atomic operations for concurrency control.

classes.name: LocklessQueue
classes.description: A lock-free, multi-producer, single-consumer queue template class.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: Internal class representing a node in the queue, holding a value and a pointer to the next node.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if both push and pop lists are empty.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds a new element to the queue in a lock-free manner.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns an element from the queue if available, otherwise returns nullopt.
